AI insights

This report is based on Monnit sensor data from 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-23. Peak temperature was 26.7°C in Toilet down on 23 August at 16:40; the lowest was 21.2°C in Study on 22 August at 08:00. Humidity peaked at 64.4% in Ensuite on 20 August at 10:30 and fell to a low of 43.6% in Toilet down on 23 August at 16:50. The tightest condensation margin was 4.3°C in Loft 2, above the 3°C elevated-risk threshold. Against the CIBSE Guide A comfort standard (21°C living areas, 18°C bedrooms, 40-60% RH), Hall was most comfortable at 22.7°C and 54.0% humidity, closest to its 21.0°C target; Bed 3 was furthest off at 24.2°C against an 18.0°C target, despite humidity of 50.8% within range. Daily mean indoor temperature climbed to an early peak of 24.2°C on 18 August before easing to 22.8°C by 22 August. The sharpest swing was a 1.9°C rise in Toilet down between 16:10 and 16:40 on 22 August, consistent with hot water use, while Ensuite humidity jumped 10.1 points between 10:00 and 10:30 on 20 August, consistent with a shower or bath.
